page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Catchword "PHI-" at the lower right below the last line. No running head, page number or marginal notes.

main_text.p: spurcata sunt, abstergere, mirabuntur splendo-rem, qui pedibus conculcant.

Age igitur Candide Lector sine præoccupatio-nibus ad utriusque partis argumentorum respon-sorumque examen, sincerus judex accede. Ra-tiones, non verba expende; stilum cuique liberum ne morare nostris laboribus in publicam utilita-tem sudatis fruere, vitia quæ facile in opus ejus-modi labuntur, eo quo scribimus, veritatis stu-dio corrige; ut intelligas, quæ sequuntur, quæ pra-cedunt lege; nec te principia, si forte spinosa, deterreant, quibus non magno labore superatis, fructus decerpes suavissimos, in solutione multa-rum quæstionum quæ hactenus manent insolu-ta; adversus quas vere Philosophorum solidas ra-tiones expectantes, scurrarum ac Blateronum cavilla non moramur, qui derisores deridere va-leamus.

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout. Small stray mark at the right margin near the last line (not text, not transcribed). Printed text is a fragment at the top; the first paragraph continues from the previous page. "Blateronum" is set with a decorated initial B; transcribed as B.
